meta.name: governance-transition-framework
meta.description: Use when transitioning from conquest to stabilization or diagnosing dynastic failure. Applies the principle that 取与守不同术也 (taking and keeping power require different methods), shifting from military force (诈力) to benevolence and adaptability (顺权).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析政权从征服到稳定的转型策略
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果研究历史政权更迭或治理策略转型。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze transition strategies from conquest to stabilization
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you study historical regime transitions or governance strategy shifts.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会帮你判断当前是“夺取权力”还是“巩固治理”阶段，并建议从军事强权转向仁政适应的策略。
howto.when: 当你询问国家治理、政权过渡或王朝兴衰问题时触发，特别是从战争转向和平治理的场景。

say.text: 我刚占领了一个地区，接下来该怎么治理？
say.note: 它会分析当前阶段并给出治理建议

say.text: 为什么历史上很多王朝统一后就衰败了？
say.note: 它会用“取与守不同术”的原理解释

howto.what_en: After installed, Claude helps you assess whether you are in a 'conquest' or 'stabilization' phase, and advises shifting from military force to benevolent governance.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about state governance, regime transition, or dynastic rise and fall, especially transitioning from war to peace.

say_en.text: I just conquered a region, how should I govern it now?
say_en.note: It analyzes the phase and gives advice

say_en.text: Why do many dynasties collapse soon after unification?
